criteria.description: Password stored in users table after registration is a bcrypt hash matching /^\$2[aby]?\$/, never the submitted plaintext.

criteria.evidence: auth.test.ts: 'issues a JWT carrying userId, email, and username claims' PASSED (53ms). Test splits token on '.', asserts length 3, decodes middle segment (base64url), asserts all three claims.

criteria.description: src/benchmark-backend/src/middleware/requireJwt.ts exists, exports requireJwt, reads secret exclusively from process.env.JWT_SECRET (no hardcoded secret), attaches decoded payload on valid token and calls next(), returns 401 without calling next() on missing/invalid/expired token.
criteria.evidence: File present; only secret reference is 'jwt.verify(token, process.env.JWT_SECRET as string)' (line 14) — no hardcoded secret string. On valid token: req.jwtUser = decoded; next() called. On missing/invalid: res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }) returned. Tests 14 ('returns 401 when no Authorization header is provided') and 15 ('returns 401 for a malformed or invalid token') both PASSED.
